summary: Tested OnboardingTour.jsx PT-PT translation and behavior end-to-end via Playwright on the preview URL. All 5 review-request scenarios PASSED. Tour appears automatically on /dashboard for info@construpilot.pt with cleared localStorage and construpilot_lang='pt'. All 4 steps render 100% PT-PT (Passo, Seguinte, Concluir, Saltar o tour, Comparador de preços, antes/depois, profissional qualificado, casa de banho). Zero FR strings detected (searched: Étape, Suivant, Terminer, Passer, Bienvenue, profitez, pendant, Écrivez, Comparateur, avant/après, salle de bain, qualifié, Rénover). X-close (data-testid='onboarding-skip') removes overlay from DOM (count=0), sets localStorage.onboarding_skipped='1' and construpilot_onboarded_v1 to ISO date '2026-09-07T00:27:55.187Z'. Header link (/prix) is clickable after close and navigates to /precos. Tour does NOT reappear after page.reload() or re-navigation to /dashboard. Step navigation: 3 clicks on 'Seguinte' reach 'PASSO 4 / 4' and the primary button correctly shows 'Concluir'.

issues: Dashboard onboarding checklist card 'Prise en main — 0/3' and items 'Estimez vos travaux / Mesurez un plan / Créez un devis' plus CTA buttons 'Estimer / Mesurer / Créer' are still in FR even with construpilot_lang='pt'. Also 'Push bloqué' badge is FR. Not part of OnboardingTour.jsx but visible on same page after tour closes.

action_items: OnboardingTour.jsx PT-PT migration is complete and working correctly — no action needed.
OUT-OF-SCOPE observation for main agent: the Dashboard 'Prise en main' checklist card and 'Push bloqué' label are still hardcoded in FR; consider adding i18n keys and PT translations.
critical_code_review_comments: OnboardingTour.jsx header comment (lines 9-12) is still in FR ('Tour produit 4 étapes...'); cosmetic only, does not affect UI.
close() writes both KEY and SKIP_KEY on every close (X, Skip link, Concluir, goTo) — correct and idempotent.
useEffect guard order in mount is correct (onboarding_completed → SKIP_KEY → legacy KEY) and prevents re-open after reload.
test_credentials: info@construpilot.pt / Ruquinha2020. (user does NOT have onboarding_completed=true on backend — the tour did appear after clearing localStorage).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing test user info@construpilot.pt with cleared localStorage + construpilot_lang='pt'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OnboardingTour PT-PT migration verified in iteration_19. Reproduction: (1) goto /, localStorage.clear() + setItem('construpilot_lang','pt'), (2) login as info@construpilot.pt, (3) tour auto-opens on /dashboard after ~700ms. If tour does NOT appear, check backend user.onboarding_completed flag — it must be false/undefined for this user. Data-testids in use: onboarding-overlay, onboarding-tour, onboarding-skip, onboarding-next, onboarding-goto, onboarding-channel.
rca of the issue: No bug present. All requirements met.
